name: KPI Diagnostic
summary: A number turned red. Ten statements show whether the cause is clarity, skill, capacity, process design or ownership, with first moves for each.

name: 5 Whys
summary: Move from a symptom to a root cause you can change, then agree one countermeasure, one owner and one check. Print it or save it as PDF.

name: Damage Control
summary: Log damaged units by stage and cause. See the damage rate, DPMO and sigma level, the few causes behind most of it, and where to start.

name: Incomplete Control
summary: Log orders that left without every item or parcel. See the incomplete rate, DPMO and sigma level, the causes behind most misses, and where they start.

name: Delay Analyzer
summary: Log planned and actual route times. See the on-time rate, how much delay starts at the dock and how much on the road, and the reasons and hours behind it.

name: Sigma & Control Chart
summary: Turn defects into a sigma level, combine on time, undamaged and complete into perfect delivery, and see whether a bad day is a signal or noise.

name: Pareto 80/20
summary: Which few causes make most of your delays, errors, idle time or complaints? Templates for delivery, warehouse and hotel, CSV and Excel import, a checked chart.

name: Last-Mile CX Control Tower
summary: Perfect Delivery per order, on time, incomplete, damage, cold chain, loading and departures, partner and driver scorecards, route risk, root-cause Pareto, actions and a weekly review. Reads your Excel workbook.

name: Six Sigma in the Warehouse
summary: DMAIC in five steps on one warehouse case, with the tool to use at each step, three questions per step, the eight wastes and a project charter.

name: Shift Handover
summary: Numbers, open issues with an owner and a time, heads-up and safety in one handover. Open issues carry over to the next shift by themselves.

name: Shift Pulse
summary: Damage, incomplete orders, late routes and open handover issues in one picture, by day or week. Trend charts and rates, flags for what is above usual, and a summary to copy or print.

name: CV Builder
summary: A designer-quality CV on live A4 pages: photo, key figures, and company logos found from a website. In English, German or Albanian, saved as PDF.

name: ATS CV
summary: Drop in the CV you have, as PDF or Word. Get a clean one-column version that application software reads, matched to the job ad, as PDF, Word or text.

name: Cover Letter
summary: The letter in the same design as your CV, with your details taken from it and a first draft from a few answers. PDF or Word.
